items: 饮食记录支持上传食物图片，由 AI 识别后估算热量
图片最多 4 张，每张不超过 5 MB，自动压缩后上传
设置页新增语言切换：简体中文（默认）与 English
英文界面覆盖全部页面，切换后立即生效
更新日志弹窗支持中英文显示
items_en: Food logging now accepts photos; AI recognizes them to estimate calories
Up to 4 images, 5 MB each, compressed before upload
Language switch in Settings: Simplified Chinese (default) or English
English UI covers all pages and switches instantly
Changelog dialog shows both Chinese and English
